p1_findings.finding: M219 retains all 18,432 Acc24 context bits as flip-flops. They account for 93.091% of its 19,800 sequential cells and drive a 19,800-load clock plus a reset tree reported at 19,795 loads.
p1_findings.impact: The cropped K1 point successfully isolates service datapath/control sensitivity, but the absolute area and reset/clock burden are dominated by a register implementation of future context storage.
p1_findings.required_followup: Replace bulk-reset context FF data with a macro adapter that resets or epoch-fences only validity/ownership state; then evaluate propagated clocks and physical buffering.

p1_findings.finding: Both M218 and M219 logic-only DC runs contain zero SRAM macros. M219 retains a 3-bit bank identity and the contract retains eight equal-capacity external banks, but neither run prices bank macros, ports, output muxing, response timing or memory energy.
p1_findings.impact: The 15.604369% final cell-area overhead is fair only for the matched service logic/register scope, not for total accelerator area or energy.
p1_findings.required_followup: Instantiate one common eight-bank macro adapter, preserve equal capacity and identity, and include finite port/latency/backpressure costs in the A/B.

p1_findings.finding: The final M218-minus-M219 area delta is 11,993.183859 um2, of which 5,700.491875 um2 is buf/inv. Rounded min-path pre-repair areas are approximately 82,407.0 and 75,802.7 um2, while final-area growth is about 7.820% for M218 and 1.392% for M219.
p1_findings.impact: The exact final area ratio includes strongly unequal hold-repair cost. It must not be described as intrinsic eight-lane arithmetic overhead or extrapolated to a placed-and-routed implementation.
p1_findings.required_followup: Report both useful-state/datapath composition and timing-repair cells; repeat after macro integration and CTS/route.

p1_findings.finding: Combining the separately reviewed frozen-H67 premodel ratio 4.952121572835196x with the two logic-only DC areas yields 4.283680292008414x conditional service throughput per logic-area sensitivity.
p1_findings.impact: This is algebra over a fixed-latency premodel and pre-macro areas, not measured RTL throughput/area, complete-FC2 performance or a fair total-product metric.
p1_findings.required_followup: Replay frozen H67 traffic through a connected M216/service/macro recurrence, measure RTL cycles, and include shared frontend and memory area before performance-per-area admission.

p1_findings.finding: M219 meets setup at +0.3764 ns and hold at exactly 0.0000 ns under an ideal clock and ZeroWireload; DC substitutes fanout 1,000 for high-fanout timing and the final netlist has 1,935 delay cells.
p1_findings.impact: The exact pre-macro check passes, but there is no physical timing margin or evidence that reset/clock distribution will close after macro placement.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run macro-aware PT and ultimately CTS/place-route with propagated clocks before physical claims.

p1_findings.finding: DC reports eight VER-318 signed conversion/part-select warnings and enables sequential output inversion. Exact source VCS passes and an SVF is emitted, but RTL-to-netlist Formality has not been completed.
p1_findings.impact: No synthesis failure is observed, yet mapped bit-level equivalence is not closed.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run Formality with the exact emitted SVF and retain full-scale signed INT8/Acc24 boundary tests.

matched_m218_m219_comparison.scope: standalone service logic/register, same TSMC28 3ns ideal-clock ZeroWireload zero-macro flow

conditional_performance_area_sensitivity.source: independently reviewed frozen-H67 fixed-latency in-order L4/O8/II1 premodel plus the two matched logic-only DC areas

allowed: The exact M219 native-cropped K1 standalone service logic maps to 91,887 cells and 76,857.858437 um2 at the declared 3 ns ideal-clock, ZeroWireload, zero-macro TSMC-28nm point.
At the same logic/register DC point, M218 K8 is 15.604369% larger in final cell area than M219 K1 while retaining the same 18,432-bit Acc24 context capacity.

Combining the separately reviewed frozen-H67 premodel cycle ratio with these two pre-macro logic areas gives a conditional algebraic service throughput/logic-area sensitivity of 4.283680292x; this is not achieved RTL or total-accelerator performance.
forbidden: Fair total-accelerator throughput per area or energy efficiency
Paper-ready PPA, routed timing, SRAM-aware area or memory energy
Complete FC2, complete FFN, physical or system speedup
Any headline comparison against Prosperity, Phi or another accelerator
A claim that 15.604369% is intrinsic K8 arithmetic cost independent of hold repair and physical implementation
